bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.title: Malformed run state accepted silently
bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.description: A run.json missing required fields (goal, mode) is not rejected by execute_run. The run completes with status='completed' and no error.
bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.recommendation: Add upfront schema validation in create_run/execute_run (or a dedicated run state validator) that rejects runs missing required fields with status=failed and a descriptive error.

bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.title: Auto write-intent escalation not reflected in run state
bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.description: governance.mode_requires_escalation correctly detects auto+write intent, but create_run/execute_run keep mode_effective=auto instead of escalating to build_required/auto-build.
bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.recommendation: When mode_requires_escalation returns true, set mode_effective='build_required' and status='blocked' or 'escalated' in the run state before scheduling any write tool.

bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.title: No internal timeout/circuit-breaker for graph invocation
bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.description: execute_run invokes the graph without an internal timeout. A stalled node causes the call to hang until the external client times out or the process is killed.
bugs_exposed_for_future_fix.recommendation: Wrap graph invocation in a timeout (e.g., asyncio.wait_for or threading.Timer) and return status='failed' with a timeout error, possibly with a partial checkpoint.
